rata536.title: rata_536's remastered cars
rata536.author: rata_536
rata536.about: Every car of the game rebuilt in higher quality, with new sounds, real colours and fixed gearing, plus the police and traffic cars and PSX-style loading slides. Same cars and tracks, they just look and sound much better.

rata_536.name: rata_536
rata_536.about: remade every car of the PC game in higher quality, plus the police, the traffic and more.

mods.title: El Niño
mods.author: rata_536
mods.replaces: El Niño and Pursuit El Niño
mods.about: The bonus car rebuilt much closer to the PSX version, with its pursuit version, PSX-style loading slides and sharper cornering.

mods.title: Ferrari 355 F1 Spider
mods.author: rata_536
mods.about: A new model with sharper textures, engine sound from real car samples and gearing that no longer skips shifts.

mods.title: Mercedes-Benz CLK-GTR
mods.author: rata_536
mods.about: A new model, cleaner sounds from NFS: High Stakes on the PSX, and performance checked against the real car.

mods.title: Lamborghini Countach 25th
mods.author: rata_536
mods.about: The model redone from Gran Turismo 7 blueprints, with a new sound, tuned performance and rare factory colours.

mods.title: Lamborghini Diablo SV (all versions)
mods.author: rata_536
mods.replaces: the Diablo SV, Pursuit Diablo and AI interceptor
mods.about: All three Diablos rebuilt: the racer, the pursuit car and the PSX-style interceptor the AI police drive.

mods.title: Ferrari 550 Maranello
mods.author: rata_536
mods.about: A new model with 3D headlights, High Stakes PSX sounds and extra colours, including Blu Tour de France.

mods.title: Ferrari 456M GT
mods.author: rata_536
mods.about: A higher quality model, the real Ferrari shades (Verde Mugello at last) and gearing that no longer skips shifts.

mods.title: Jaguar XJR-15
mods.author: rata_536
mods.about: A new model traced from Forza Horizon 5, a fixed steering wheel and a white car for Ace.

mods.title: Jaguar XK8 and XKR
mods.author: rata_536
mods.about: Both Jaguars rebuilt, with fixed dashboard views, corrected colours and a coupé or convertible body for each.

mods.title: Italdesign Scighera
mods.author: rata_536
mods.about: Now four-wheel drive like the real car, with real Alfa Romeo colours, a new engine sound, showcase and loading slide.

mods.title: Chevrolet Corvette C5
mods.author: rata_536
mods.replaces: the Corvette, Pursuit Corvette and pace car
mods.about: The Corvette, its pursuit version and the pace car, with a sound built from High Stakes PSX samples and real gearing.

mods.title: Mercedes-Benz SL600 (R129)
mods.author: rata_536
mods.about: A higher quality model, a centred dashboard view and corrected colours that the AI uses too.

mods.title: Aston Martin DB7
mods.author: rata_536
mods.about: A new model, new sound samples, a cleaner dashboard and colours checked against real photos.

mods.title: Lister Storm
mods.author: rata_536
mods.about: A new model, a dashboard drawn from scratch, a better sound, and the car now races against you as an AI too.

mods.title: Spectre R42
mods.author: rata_536
mods.about: Rebuilt with better proportions and performance matched to the real car, now in class B where it belongs.

mods.title: HSV VT GTS
mods.author: rata_536
mods.about: A new model and player sound, a centred dashboard, the real colours, and the police now call it a Commodore.

mods.title: Ford Falcon EL
mods.author: rata_536
mods.replaces: the Falcon and the Atlantica police cruiser
mods.about: The Falcon rebuilt (no more lawnmower sound), plus a matching police cruiser for Atlantica.

mods.title: Mercedes-Benz Unimog 404
mods.author: rata_536
mods.about: The Knockout bonus truck rebuilt, with gearing matched to the real Unimog.

mods.title: HQ Police pack
mods.author: rata_536
mods.about: Every police car that chases you in races, rebuilt in high quality with new liveries.

mods.title: Lamborghini Countach (Pursuit)
mods.author: rata_536
mods.about: A police Countach for class B pursuits, with radar on the dashboard and its own loading slide.

mods.title: HSV VT GTS (Pursuit)
mods.author: rata_536
mods.about: A police GTS for class C pursuits, with radar on the dashboard and a PSX-style loading slide.

mods.title: Aston Martin DB7 (Pursuit)
mods.author: rata_536
mods.about: A police DB7 for class C pursuits, with radar on the dashboard and a PSX-style loading slide.

mods.title: HQ Traffic pack
mods.author: rata_536
mods.about: All the traffic you weave through, rebuilt; each car shows its GO code on the licence plate so you can drive it.

mods.title: Consistent race slides pack
mods.author: rata_536
mods.about: Every car's loading slide redone in one PSX style that matches the track loading screens.

mods.title: Knuckles the Echidna
mods.author: rata_536
mods.about: Exactly what it says. A joke car with far more power than it should have.
